decisions.subject: Heavyweight book
decisions.lean: Concentrating Flagship's genuine conviction — financials + quality — into a defensively-tilted book, not chasing the Goldilocks label the tape is fighting. The macro read is split: Q1 Goldilocks with expanding liquidity, but two VALIDATED planes dissent risk_off (growth-scare/defensive-rotation 66/100, mtf trail-breaches) and the shadow posture is ROTATE_DEFENSIVE. So I press the desk's best-scored, value/quality names and hold ~38% cash rather than max-invest. RF (100/100, +1.00, cheap, asymmetry 2.12) is my top weight; QUAL (Flagship's largest position, the quality factor that leads in a scare) is the defensive anchor; SCHW (+0.60, PEG 0.81) and V (+0.60, toll-road payments) diversify the financials tilt across bank/broker/payments sub-sectors; SMH is a deliberately light toehold in the RS leader because semis are the frothiest, most top-exposed group (-11% 20d). I omit LLY and XLF entirely — both are outside the 21-name published universe and can't be held. No weight-IC/edge history exists yet (89 picks in progress), so per instruction I lean on the firm's highest-rated names rather than my own sizing skill.
decisions.thesis: Exited LLY and XLF in full — both fall outside the 21-name firm-published universe and cannot be held (would be dropped anyway). No conviction loss: XLF's financials thesis is expressed more precisely through RF/SCHW; LLY (pharma) has no place in the current financials/quality concentration.

decisions.subject: China book
decisions.lean: Defensively-tilted HK barbell for a clean risk-off, stagflation regime with PBoC liquidity contracting and the desk posture on ROTATE_DEFENSIVE (offense budget 0.43). Doctrine is confirmation over prediction: I lean into what has already turned — SOE dividend banks (positive 20d momentum, above 200d trend) and innovative-drug momentum (CSPC) — while keeping quality internet (Tencent (0700.HK), Alibaba (9988.HK)) held but not pressed. The income ballast is ICBC (1398.HK), China Construction Bank (0939.HK), Bank of China (3988.HK), China Mobile (0941.HK) and Power Assets (0006.HK). I trim China Life (2628.HK) as an insurance laggard, keep Ping An (2318.HK) as the better insurer, and open a half-size starter in Chow Tai Fook (1929.HK) — the desk's one genuine high-conviction HK BUY ZONE, a gold/jewelry play that fits the high copper/gold + stagflation backdrop. I hold ~28% cash as deliberate dry powder against elevated drawdown risk and contracting liquidity. NAV is measured vs FXI, which this book largely mirrors on the large-cap financials/internet core.

Marginally trimmed Tencent (0700.HK) ~15%→14% and Alibaba stayed ~6% — quality internet held but not pressed into a tech pullback.
